_comment: Example den-host configuration. Copy to den-host.json and adjust for your environment. Do not commit secrets; use DEN_HOST_CORE_API_KEY / DEN_HOST_CHANNELS_API_KEY env vars instead.

Adapter._comment_ManagedRoles: Historical host-level role claims. Leave empty for FleetOps-only operation; den-host is not the active worker wake/coordination path.

Core._comment_ApiKey: Set DEN_HOST_CORE_API_KEY env var instead of filling this in.

Channels._comment: Optional legacy den-channels cold-history/readback only. Leave paths empty for normal FleetOps-only operation; do not use den-channels direct-agent routes as a worker wake source.
Channels._comment_ApiKey: Only set DEN_HOST_CHANNELS_API_KEY when deliberately reading archived legacy Channels evidence.

Settings._comment: Hermes module is the first concrete harness. Set binary_path / profile / home for your install. 'roles' is a CSV of Den-facing role names this module satisfies.
